  "decision_kind" text,
  "decision_note" text,
  "desired_text" text,
  "due_soon_notified_at" timestamptz,
  "fee_window" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotency_key" text NOT NULL,
  "in_progress_at" timestamptz,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,

  "notice_item_code" text,
  "notice_version_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "order_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "overdue_notified_at" timestamptz,
  "reason_kind" text NOT NULL,
  "reason_text" text,
  "received_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "refund_account_id" uuid,
  "reservation_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'received' NOT NULL,
  "suggested_amount" int4,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "withdrawn_at" timestamptz,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_refund_requests_amount_307c7b1d" CHECK (decided_amount IS NULL OR decided_amount >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_refund_requests_calc_amounts_4c2dfcd0" CHECK ((suggested_amount IS NULL OR suggested_amount >= 0) AND (base_amount IS NULL OR base_amount >= 0) AND (cancel_fee_amount IS NULL OR cancel_fee_amount >= 0) AND (cancel_fee_bp IS NULL OR cancel_fee_bp BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_refund_requests_decided_4f37451c" CHECK ((status NOT IN ('completed', 'rejected') OR decided_at IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'completed' OR completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'withdrawn' OR withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_refund_requests_event_amount_ed50bc59" CHECK (kind <> 'event' OR decided_amount IS NULL OR suggested_amount IS NULL OR decided_amount >= suggested_amount),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_refund_requests_event_final_26a28c59" CHECK (kind <> 'event' OR (decision_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'rejected' AND status <> 'withdrawn')),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_refund_requests_reject_item_b5152285" CHECK (decision_kind IS DISTINCT FROM 'rejected' OR notice_item_code IS NOT NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_refund_requests_text_len_2016917c" CHECK ((reason_text IS NULL OR char_length(reason_text) <= 500) AND (desired_text IS NULL OR char_length(desired_text) <= 500) AND (decision_note IS NULL OR char_length(decision_note) <= 500)),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_requests_decision_kind_check_7730f052" CHECK ("decision_kind" IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'auto')),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_requests_fee_window_check_8c846ed5" CHECK ("fee_window" IN ('same_day', 'paid_within_7d_full', 'd10_plus', 'd9_d7', 'd6_d3', 'd2_to_deadline')),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_requests_kind_check_3e5b088f" CHECK ("kind" IN ('regular', 'event')),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_requests_reason_kind_check_a63c439f" CHECK ("reason_kind" IN ('personal', 'schedule_change', 'other')),
  CONSTRAINT "refund_requests_status_check_8a151ab6" CHECK ("status" IN ('received', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'rejected', 'withdrawn'))
)
